goal: Implement two independent formatters, then integrate and verify both.
constraints: Use low effort for ordinary tasks, medium for moderate tasks, high for complex tasks; keep the execution model fixed
Workers author only their owned source and test files; the main Agent runs checks and owns Git, dependency installation and shared build/cache writes

tasks.inputs: Date format contract is fixed; input is an ISO date string
tasks.acceptance: Specified valid and invalid date examples pass

tasks.summary: Implement currency rounding with multiple established rounding modes and boundary cases
tasks.inputs: Currency and rounding contracts are fixed; reconcile precision and negative-value edge cases across the supported modes
tasks.acceptance: Specified currency and rounding examples pass

tasks.summary: Integrate formatters with locale fallback and cross-module error guarantees
tasks.inputs: Fixed locale fallback and public error contracts; accepted date and money artifacts; verify interactions across both modules
tasks.deliverable: Integrated public API and validation report
tasks.acceptance: Public API examples and relevant existing checks pass

plans.description: Independent writes: ordinary date implementation uses low effort; moderate multi-case currency logic uses medium
Run the ordinary date task first at low effort when parallel execution is not semantically appropriate
After both artifacts are accepted, use high effort for complex cross-module fallback and error consistency
